issues.description: play.ts committed as personal scratchpad with debug console.logs
issues.detail: This is exactly the kind of garbage that wastes a maintainer's time. play.ts now imports from a relative source path and dumps console.log output for a manual repro. Either delete it from the diff, or it doesn't land. Scratch files belong in your branch, not in the PR.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: file processor refactor bundled with metadata fix
issues.detail: The fileProcessor change in json-schema-processors.ts and the snapshot churn for z.file() are a separate semantic change about how anyOf factorizes shared props. It's unrelated to metadata tracking across child-parent. Split it. One patch, one thing. The reviewer cannot bisect a regression in file emission against a metadata refactor.

issues.description: overrideCount doubles from 6 to 12 with no explanation
issues.detail: A test assertion that says 'do not run on references' just had its expected count doubled. Either the override is now firing on references (which the test name says must not happen and which the previous !seen.isParent guard prevented), or the semantics of the test changed. Removing the isParent guard in finalize and updating the number is not a justification. Explain why this is correct, in the commit message, or refuse.

issues.description: JSON.stringify deep-equality used as deduplication check
issues.detail: Twice in finalize you compare schema[key] to def[key] via JSON.stringify round-trip. That is slow, order-sensitive, and silently wrong on undefined, functions, or any non-canonical key ordering. For a hot path that runs over every seen entry this is bad taste. Write a real structural compare or document precisely why stringify is sufficient here.

issues.description: Two overlapping dedup loops doing nearly the same work
issues.detail: The isParentRef branch deletes keys not in _cached. The refSchema.$ref branch deletes keys that stringify-equal the def. Then the seen.parent block does a third nearly-identical dedup against parentSeen.def. Three special cases where one general traversal of the inheritance chain would do. This is the exact special-case-instead-of-general pattern to eliminate.

issues.description: Commented-out parent: true line in mini was load-bearing context
issues.detail: The mini/schemas.ts change flips a commented-out option live. Fine, but the commit message should say so and the test suite for mini should demonstrate the same metadata-inheritance behavior the classic test added. Otherwise the next maintainer has no idea why mini and classic diverged for a release.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The core idea — track parent separately from processor ref so $ref propagates correctly through wrappers — is reasonable and the new test for readonly().meta({id}).describe() actually demonstrates the fix. But the patch is at least three patches glued together: metadata propagation, fileProcessor refactor, and a play.ts scratch file. The finalize() rewrite leans on JSON.stringify equality and three overlapping dedup loops where one general pass over the inheritance chain belongs. The overrideCount doubling and the removal of the isParent guard need a written justification, not just a new number. Split the patch, drop play.ts, explain the override semantics change, and resubmit.
